hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parking
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side near the intersection may block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the stop sign

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Trash bins are placed directly on the narrow sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to navigate around them or potentially step into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-right, on the sidewalk in front of the grey house.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, cars parked along the curb.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the left curb block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians, particularly children, who may attempt to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway along the residential frontage

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: The absence of designated crossing points over a long stretch of residential road forces pedestrians to cross unprotected.

hazards.name: Lack of curb ramps
hazards.description: The transition from the internal park path to the roadway lacks a sloped curb ramp, creating a barrier for users with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground where the concrete path meets the street curb

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: There is no marked crosswalk where the internal path meets the street, which may lead to unpredictable pedestrian movements and reduced driver awareness.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway area directly in front of the path terminus

hazards.name: Parked vehicle sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parallel parked cars on the right side of the street can block the view between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are located directly in the narrow sidewalk path on the right side of the image, forcing pedestrians to maneuver around them.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway along the brick building

hazards.name: Narrow Walkway
hazards.description: The existing sidewalk on the left is very narrow and lacks any buffer from the adjacent travel lane.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the travel lane with no planting strip or parked cars to separate pedestrians from moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire length of the visible sidewalk

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs visible along this stretch of road.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The concrete sidewalk slabs are uneven, cracked, and partially covered by grass, creating significant tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Running horizontally across the middle ground

hazards.name: Poor drainage and debris
hazards.description: Standing water and mud along the left curb line may force pedestrians to walk closer to the travel lane or create slip hazards.

hazards.name: Lack of Roadway Markings
hazards.description: The absence of lane markings on a wide street can lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning and higher speeds.

hazards.name: Degraded Walkway
hazards.description: The walkway on the right side of the image is narrow, cracked, and partially overgrown, creating a tripping hazard and accessibility barrier.

hazards.name: Degraded Buffer Zone
hazards.description: The area between the curb and the sidewalk is muddy and unpaved, creating a tripping hazard or barrier for anyone attempting to access the sidewalk from the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, between the asphalt and the concrete walkway

hazards.name: Lack of Protected Crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs visible along this stretch of road, despite the presence of institutional buildings.

hazards.name: Wide Driveway Curb Cut
hazards.description: A wide vehicle access point crosses the sidewalk, creating a conflict zone between pedestrians and turning vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left, leading into the parking area.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The presence of a fenced-off parking lot creates a lack of 'eyes on the street' and a less engaging pedestrian environment.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right side of the image behind the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Large patches and cracks in the asphalt create uneven surfaces for anyone crossing the street.

hazards.name: Debris and Poor Gutter Condition
hazards.description: Accumulated dirt and debris along the curb line may indicate poor drainage and can create slipping hazards.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs visible along this stretch of road.

hazards.name: Utility pole obstruction
hazards.description: A large wooden utility pole is situated in the middle of the sidewalk, reducing the effective width and creating a barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Gap
hazards.description: The right side of the street lacks a paved sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk on the unpaved shoulder or in the roadway.

hazards.name: Roadside Obstruction
hazards.description: Large black trash bags are piled on the right edge of the roadway, obstructing the walking path and potentially forcing pedestrians into the travel lane.

hazards.name: Debris and Trash Pile
hazards.description: A large pile of trash bags and loose debris is located on the verge between the sidewalk and the road, which could attract pests or eventually obstruct the walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, left side of the image on the grass/dirt verge.

hazards.name: Degraded walkway surface
hazards.description: The paved area on the right side of the road is broken, uneven, and partially covered in debris, creating trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway along the stone wall

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide street can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable driver behavior.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe walking path.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to designate safe crossing locations.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and security after dark.

interventions.title: Roadway Striping
interventions.description: Apply standard lane markings to define travel lanes and encourage more predictable driver behavior.

interventions.title: Drainage Improvements
interventions.description: Repair or clear the gutter system to prevent water and sediment accumulation at the curb.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Designated Trash Storage
interventions.description: Implement designated off-sidewalk trash storage areas to ensure the pedestrian clear zone is maintained.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees or planters to provide a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, which also helps calm traffic speeds.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential and park-adjacent context.

interventions.title: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps
interventions.description: Provide a level transition between the sidewalk/path and the roadway to ensure accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: High-visibility marked crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian path across the roadway.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Add a furniture zone with trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk
interventions.description: Construct a standard-width paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a continuous pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and signage to provide a safe crossing point between the building and the park area.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install LED street lighting on existing utility poles to improve nighttime visibility and security.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Prune low-hanging branches to improve visibility and clear the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Enhanced Street Lighting
interventions.description: Improve street lighting to mitigate the deep shadows created by the tree canopy, improving nighttime safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Utility Relocation
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk on the left and relocate utility poles to a furniture zone to ensure a clear walking path.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks with appropriate curb ramps at logical crossing points.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Replace the existing degraded slabs with a continuous, level, and ADA-compliant concrete walkway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians using the walkway and the adjacent park area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Resurface the sidewalk to provide a smooth, accessible walking surface free of tripping hazards.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Install street trees or a planting strip to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Add lane markings to define the travel way and consider curb extensions to narrow the perceived road width.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks to provide safe points for pedestrians to cross between the residential buildings and the open green space.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees on the left side would provide a buffer and help narrow the visual field for drivers, potentially reducing speeds.

interventions.title: Pave Buffer or Add Access Points
interventions.description: Pave the buffer zone or provide frequent paved connections between the curb and the sidewalk to ensure accessible and stable footing.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Plant street trees in the buffer zone to provide shade, improve the aesthetic environment, and create a more substantial vertical buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalks on both sides and relocate utility poles to a dedicated furniture zone to ensure a clear, accessible path.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with pedestrian-actuated warning beacons to facilitate safe crossing between the building and the green space.

interventions.title: Street Tree Planting
interventions.description: Add street trees on the right side to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation or Narrowing
interventions.description: Narrow the driveway entrance to reduce vehicle speeds and the distance pedestrians are exposed to traffic.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the degraded pavement to ensure a smooth and safe surface for all road users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair cracks and remove vegetation growing through the sidewalk to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction and Widening
interventions.description: Repair the existing sidewalks to provide a smooth, ADA-compliant surface and widen them to at least 5-6 feet.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and curb extensions at the nearest intersection to improve pedestrian visibility and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicles while improving the streetscape.

interventions.title: Sanitation and Maintenance
interventions.description: Implement regular trash pickup and site maintenance to keep the pedestrian buffer clear and sanitary.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation and Expansion
interventions.description: Repair the degraded walkway on the right and widen the existing sidewalk on the left to meet NACTO accessibility standards.

interventions.title: Streetscape Enhancements
interventions.description: Add street trees and pedestrian-scale lighting to improve comfort, shade, and visibility.

interventions.title: On-Street Parking or Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Delineate on-street parking or add bike lanes to narrow the perceived width of the travel lanes and slow traffic.
